The '''Otavon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]], which was ruled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hidden Blade" />

==Behind the scenes==
There are two Otavon systems in ''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion.
